records.question: 3 attempts and now I'm locked out, is that normal?
records.answer: Yes, that is normal. According to our policy, your account automatically locks for 15 minutes after 3 failed login attempts for security purposes. During this 15-minute window, the system will not send a password reset email. Please wait 15 minutes and then try using the "Forgot Password" link again. If you are still unable to log in after waiting, please let us know so we can escalate this to our Tier 2 team for a manual unlock.

records.question: I want to go to Account Settings, Subscription, then Cancel Plan -- what happens after that?
records.answer: After you select 'Cancel Plan' in your Account Settings, your subscription will remain active until the end of your current billing cycle. Please note that there are no partial refunds for any remaining days. Once the cancellation is effective, your account data will be retained for 90 days, giving you the opportunity to reactivate your subscription if you choose. After those 90 days, your data will be permanently deleted.
records.judge_reason: The agent correctly identified the steps to cancel, gathered the relevant information from the search results, and accurately synthesized the consequences of the cancellation as requested by the customer.
